name: BizMaker

sources.title: Homepage — generic B2B/local business directory; 'Join For Free'; part of a 16-site 'FREE Listing Sites' network
Join page — 'Join For Free', continues to /checkout/1; member login and free account creation links

requirements: Free member account (email + password); 'Join For Free' / 'Create Free User Account'
Generic business directory with category + location structure — any business fits, including SaaS
Join flow routes through /checkout/1 despite the 'free' claim — a $0 checkout or paid upsell step may appear
preparation: Email and password for a member account
Business name, category, location, description, website URL
Logo/image if the listing form asks
workflow: Proceed to 'Add Your Company' / checkout step and fill the business listing fields
watchFor: Part of an obvious link-farm network ('Our Family of FREE Listing Sites' — 16 sibling directories); SEO value is low and footprints like this can look spammy
The 'Join For Free' CTA lands on /checkout/1 — watch for a paid upsell inside the checkout flow
Newest member articles are syndicated spam-adjacent content (Olympics tickets, Umrah packages) — low editorial quality
Newest members include non-US locations; it's not US-local-only despite appearances
countsAsLive: A public member listing page exists at bizmaker.org/<location>/<category>/<company> and appears in 'Newest Members'/category browsing
unknowns: Whether /checkout/1 charges anything or is a $0 free checkout
